design_philosophy: Neo-Editorial Wealth Management. Combines Swiss Brutalist structural precision with Organic/Luxury warmth (Warm Sand & Obsidian). A deliberate rejection of 'fintech green' templates, focusing on high-end editorial typography, deliberate asymmetry, and cinematic motion. It feels like an exclusive, old-money boutique.

rules: Display typography must have massive scale contrast (e.g., text-6xl+ for H1, but tight leading).
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Never use pure white or pure black. Always tint neutrals (F4F1EA base, 0A0A0A text).
Use Accent (Terracotta/B84A36) strictly for critical interactive moments (CTAs).
Use Primary (Deep Forest/183226) for chart fills and massive graphic blocks.

visual_enhancers.texture: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain texture globally as a fixed overlay (mix-blend-multiply, opacity-20) to kill the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders (border-black/15) to create grid compartments (Swiss Brutalist style).
visual_enhancers.shadows: No soft diffuse shadows. Use sharp, flat block shadows or none at all. Rely on borders for definition.
visual_enhancers.radii: Keep borders mostly sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to maintain an editorial, mature look. Use rounded-full only for pill buttons.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Install and configure `@studio-freight/react-lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Kinetic Masked Reveal: Use framer-motion. Wrap text lines in 'overflow-hidden' divs, and animate the child elements' 'y' property from '100%' to '0%' with a 1s cubic-bezier ease on load.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Use framer-motion useScroll and useTransform to move massive background images or abstract shapes at a different speed than the page content.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must invert colors or shift background with framer-motion or Tailwind transitions (transition-colors duration-300 ease-out).

layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32 for sections. Let elements breathe.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid: For the 'Services' section, use the 'TETRIS' Mode grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, gap-8, mixing col-span-4 and col-span-8 blocks) to create asymmetry and visual tension.

section_blueprint.name: Navigation
section_blueprint.design: Sticky crystal glass header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F1EA]/70). 1px bottom border. Left-aligned refined logo, right-aligned WhatsApp CTA pill.

section_blueprint.name: Hero Section
section_blueprint.design: Massive kinetic typography ('Wealth, Nurtured' or similar). Line-by-line reveal. Background features a slow-moving, moody abstract architecture or subtle parallax photo. 80vh minimum height.

section_blueprint.name: Editorial Marquee
section_blueprint.design: Very slow-moving ribbon using 'react-fast-marquee'. Large outline typography or Serif text (e.g., 'DISCIPLINE • PATIENCE • RESEARCH • GROWTH'). Color: low contrast (Pale beige with dark text).

section_blueprint.name: Manifesto (Chapters)
section_blueprint.design: Numbered sections (I. Discipline, II. Strategy...). Off-grid asymmetry. Left column sticky large Roman numeral, right column scrolling text blocks and clipped-frame photography.

section_blueprint.name: Services Grid
section_blueprint.design: Tetris bento layout. Features SIP, Lumpsum, Tax-Efficient, Retirement, Education, Research. Use icons from @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone). Use borders between grid items.

section_blueprint.name: Calculators Section
section_blueprint.design: Highly functional, tech-forward. Shadcn Tabs to switch between SIP / Lumpsum / Retirement / Education. Mono-spaced numbers. Use 'recharts' for a live-updating AreaChart (Primary color fill). Client-side calculations only.

section_blueprint.name: Founder Profile & Trust
section_blueprint.design: Deep Forest Green background (#183226) with warm text. Cinematic clipped-frame portrait of the founder. Heavy emphasis on credentials (CFA L2, MBA Finance, NISM RA). AUM & Client counters animating on scroll using framer-motion.

section_blueprint.name: Floating Contact
section_blueprint.design: Fixed bottom-right WhatsApp and Phone icon buttons (Phosphor Icons). High elevation, vibrant Accent color.

section_blueprint.name: Footer
section_blueprint.design: Massive padding (py-32). Huge logo or 'Let's Talk' typography. SEBI compliance disclaimer in small mono text.

components_path_and_instructions.name: Shadcn UI
components_path_and_instructions.instructions: Use Shadcn components for UI logic (Tabs, Slider, Input) but HEAVILY strip away the default Vercel-look. Remove generic rounded borders and ring shadows. Re-style to match the editorial Brutalist/Organic theme.

components_path_and_instructions.name: Recharts
components_path_and_instructions.instructions: Install 'recharts'. Remove default axis lines/ticks for a cleaner look. Use curved lines (type='monotone') and an Area fill matching the brand's primary color.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='sip-calculator-tab', data-testid='whatsapp-cta-button', data-testid='aum-counter').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure the Accent color and Primary color text over the Bone White background meet WCAG AA standards.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract sharp architectural lines, perfect for the Brutalist tech parallax background.

founder_portrait.description: Professional Indian businessman in a suit against a dark background.

nurtured_growth.description: Miniature bonsai tree in geometric pot. Represents nurtured wealth and discipline.

wealth_lifestyle.description: High-end luxury outdoor dining/living setup, symbolizing retirement goals.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and absolute positioning.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use the specified @phosphor-icons/react library.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
CRITICAL: The site MUST be built using .js files (JavaScript), not .tsx (TypeScript).
CRITICAL: Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
CRITICAL: Ensure the header is not entirely transparent if content scrolls beneath it (use blur or solid backgrounds).
